note: AgentCard tags: which agent card types surface each published pack. Keyed by the pack ids in plugin-catalog.json / skill-catalog.json; values are agent profile ids from workflow-defaults.js / CURATED_AGENT_CATALOG. scripts/seed-plugin-catalog.js --store merges these onto the Firestore mirror records, and the workflow designer's catalog endpoint serves them so a picker can say which cards a pack belongs to.
